purpose: Lossless crosswalk of source-owned heritage evidence to canonical Places; never grants relic authenticity, apparition approval, custom distribution, or publishable coordinate status.
acceptance_rules: A Place can appear once on the unified map while retaining multiple independently owned records.
Source-backed coordinate eligibility is computed by the existing geography policy, not by this review ledger.
An AREA_CONTEXT or worldwide custom is never converted into a point.
Reference-only Places remain in the geography registry pending editorial review.
The absence of a missing-reference error is not proof of current opening times, relic authenticity or apparition approval.
Places with null latitude/longitude are pending coordinates, not false claims that a known coordinate lacks attribution.
